answer: Emission can be split by lineage before it is split by head. Each epoch's pool first divides equally among top-level invite subtrees, then within each subtree among its passing answers, the way an opal breaks one light into fixed patches of color. A farm that onboards a thousand heads under one sponsor shares a single patch, so its thousandth head earns almost nothing. Spreading out means persuading many unrelated sponsors to harbor it, each risking their own standing. Roots are fixed at join time, so no head can be replanted in another garden later.
